ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Blinkr uses your location to show nearby places and fresh signals, and to confirm you are at a place when you share a signal there. Your exact location is never shown to anyone.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Blinkr uses the camera so you can take photos or videos for your signal, story or snap.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Blinkr uses the microphone to record sound when you film a video.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Blinkr opens your photo library so you can share photos and videos you pick. Location data in photos is removed.
